description: TRY_CAST is nullable even over a NOT NULL operand, because it returns NULL on a conversion failure instead of erroring -- that is the entire point of the syntax

columns.name: parsed
columns.note: raw_amount is NOT NULL, but TRY_CAST returns NULL when the text isn't a valid integer; Snowflake has no dedicated int32 storage, so INTEGER resolves to int64 there

name: try_cast_nullable_on_failure
query_sql:
-- @name GetParsedAmount
-- @returns :many
SELECT TRY_CAST(raw_amount AS INTEGER) AS parsed FROM imports
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE imports (id INTEGER NOT NULL, raw_amount VARCHAR NOT NULL);
